solutions.title: Lookahead subtraction scan
solutions.strategy: Scan left to right and subtract a symbol when the next symbol has a larger value.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every Roman symbol is evaluated once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The symbol-value table has constant size.

solutions.title: Scan from right with max seen value
solutions.strategy: Move from right to left, subtracting values that are smaller than the largest value already seen to the right.

timeComplexity.explanation: The string is scanned once from right to left.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the running maximum symbol value and total are stored.
